name: Uzbekistan
description: Uzbekistan from Sogdiana and the Silk Road to Samarkand, Bukhara, Timur, the khanates, Russian and Soviet rule and independence.

checkpoints.name: Silk Road
checkpoints.note: Sogdian merchants traded along the Silk Road. Arab armies brought Islam, scholars such as al-Khwarizmi worked, and the Mongols laid waste the cities.

checkpoints.name: Timur and the khanates
checkpoints.note: Timur made Samarkand his capital, and Ulugh Beg studied the stars. Khanates ruled Bukhara and Khiva.

checkpoints.name: Russian and Soviet
checkpoints.note: Russia took Tashkent in 1865. The Soviets made the land grow cotton, and the Aral Sea dried up.

checkpoints.name: Independent Uzbekistan
checkpoints.note: Uzbekistan became independent in 1991, ruled by Karimov until 2016.
